hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Start with a friendlier piece: if $30\%$ of the number is $18$, how much is $10\%$ of the number?
You know a part and its percent, and you need the whole. A good path is to find what $10\%$ of the number is first.
If $30\%$ is $18$, then $10\%$ is $18 \div 3 = 6$. The whole is $100\%$, which is ten lots of $10\%$, so multiply $6$ by $10$.
Ten lots of $6$ make $6 \times 10 = 60$, so the number is $60$.

explanation: $30\%$ is three groups of $10\%$, so divide the part by $3$ to find $10\%$: $18 \div 3 = 6$.
The whole number is $100\%$, which is ten groups of $10\%$, so multiply $6 \times 10 = 60$.
Check: $30\%$ of $60$ is $0.30 \times 60 = 18$, which is the part given.
The whole number we were looking for is $60$.
